failure_modes: Conditional survivor/head-score association need not transfer to future affinity; extinct branch futures are censored and no causal effect is established.
Very weak whole-teacher cross-batch direction agreement can make the extrapolated virtual neighbour a noisy or harmful mode; positive direction must beat reversed and null controls.

Few qualified nearby teachers or RMS-normalized baseline control can make the new gradient or trajectory change negligible despite a nonzero old R26 gradient; inspect the actual mechanism and dose before efficacy.
Hungarian/nearest teacher and prior are frozen conditionally; across steps mode switches and the lagged post-native SDE injection may amplify small geometric changes without improving affinity.
Requested equal eta does not ensure equal cumulative action dose or clash backtracking; preserve raw scalar-gradient dot actual injection and separate preconditioned control inner product.

Whole-window regional covariance is not an Angstrom target or spatial gradient; overlapping ROI synthesis and mediator/confounder treatment require a new registered deterministic tool, not unbound vector splicing.
A stronger affinity on the discovery batches can be selection overfit; use frozen independent paired confirmation, retain failed-trial reports and revert to R26.
rationale: Exploratory falsification pilot, not an incumbent promotion or a reliable affinity-gradient claim. The actual bound Analyst, three complete literal Skills, all combined evidence items/functions/directional summaries, three tool receipts, multi-depth live receipt and registry/context were read after payload hash validation. Lag-two same-ancestor, distinct-immediate-parent endpoint mutations supply genuine conditional coordinate comparisons despite immediate-copy aliasing and collapsed initial roots. Joint innovation has adjusted correlation -0.149932 but adjusted absolute covariance only -3.59935e-5 A*pIC50; both survive their shared correction. This motivates a bounded experiment on intact joint teachers, not globally suppressing coordinate movement. Select the explicitly registered branch_mixture on R26_branch, reference SHA256 50d7232b5501152c87fe20329ebfa0e4b0fbfd2f519cdd0e1e6dad9b8f23f801. Change only virtual_mass alpha to 0.1: this is a conservative 10% maximum experimental mode budget chosen because instantaneous cross-batch joint-direction agreement is weak and confidence maximum is only 0.00107922. Alpha is neither calibrated confidence nor an Angstrom displacement; 90% or more of every original teacher prior remains. Freeze direction_sign at default +1, regional mix at default 0, observed natural-branch RMS capped at the registered 0.2 A, eligibility, original unshifted Hungarian correspondence/nearest teachers and original score prior. Positive d is the recorded high-score teacher minus matched lower-score natural branches within its observed ancestor, RMS-normalized jointly in world endpoint coordinates; it is a local extrapolation hypothesis with surrounding coordinates retained. Missing first-two ancestral fields, zero confidence/raw direction or absent genuine lower branches delegate exactly to R26. Use the registered differentiable original-plus-virtual pseudo-Huber mixture; differentiate only endpoint coordinates through the actual existing FLOWR endpoint VJP with self-conditioning and matching detached. Guidance support is copied dynamically from the bound learned window, followed by native continuation. Keep R26 dose ratio, caps, native RNG/SDE and free graph transitions unchanged. First require exact alpha-zero/sign-zero baseline scalar, gradient and paired-trajectory parity and nonzero mechanism-specific virtual prior/physical shift, new gradient and actual window trajectory response. Only then compare final predicted affinity against paired R26 and unguided plus historical Steer, with strain secondary. Next reverse only direction_sign at the same frozen alpha/qualification/scale/initial state and compare null; equal requested ratio is not guaranteed equal actual cumulative dose, so report RMS, action budget and clamp/backtrack rates. If response is numerically negligible, investigate measured effective dose before judging efficacy; no confidence sqrt or power-zero repair. If positive/reversed both help, additional mode smoothing or dose effects remain an alternative. Multi-depth region17/18 signed absolute associations and whole-window fits are useful future hypotheses, but the current reference field is lag-two joint contrast, not a synthesized multi-depth ROI direction. No deterministic joint overlapping-region synthesis tool/reference/formula is registered; do not fabricate one. Keep ROI synthesis deferred while testing direction, reversed direction, alpha budget and independent confidence-conditioned regional mix sequentially. Compare native-vs-gain/uniform-dose controls on the unchanged R26 scalar separately, never as simultaneous reward edits. Retain verified R26 unless responsive paired and independent confirmation establishes final affinity benefit.
